title: Imperfecto — Practice
description: Authored B1 practice set for the imperfect: regular forms, the three irregulars (ser, ir, ver), and its core uses — habits, ongoing background, description, time and age.

lessons.summary: The imperfect (imperfecto) describes the past without a defined endpoint: habits ('used to'), ongoing background actions ('was …ing'), descriptions, and time, age, weather and feelings. Regular endings — -ar verbs: -aba, -abas, -aba, -ábamos, -aban; -er/-ir verbs: -ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -ían. Only three verbs are irregular: ser (era, eras, era, éramos, eran), ir (iba, ibas, iba, íbamos, iban) and ver (veía, veías, veía, veíamos, veían).

examples.spanish: Cuando era niño, jugaba al fútbol todos los días.
examples.english: When I was a child, I used to play football every day.
It was raining and it was cold.

examples.spanish: Eran las tres de la tarde.
examples.english: It was three in the afternoon.
She was ten years old then.

examples.spanish: Íbamos a la playa cada verano.
examples.english: We used to go to the beach every summer.

items.promptEnglish: I used to speak / was speaking
items.explanation: -ar verbs take -aba in the imperfect: hablar → hablaba.

items.promptEnglish: they used to speak
items.explanation: -ar, ellos: hablaban.

items.promptEnglish: you used to eat
items.explanation: -er verbs take -ía: comer → comías.

items.promptEnglish: we used to live
items.explanation: -ir verbs take -ía: vivir → vivíamos.

items.promptEnglish: she used to work
items.explanation: -ar, ella: trabajaba.

items.promptEnglish: I used to have
items.explanation: tener is regular in the imperfect: tenía.

items.promptEnglish: I was
items.explanation: ser is irregular: era, eras, era, éramos, eran.

items.promptEnglish: we were
items.explanation: ser, nosotros: éramos.

items.promptEnglish: I used to go
items.explanation: ir is irregular: iba, ibas, iba, íbamos, iban.

items.promptEnglish: they used to go
items.explanation: ir, ellos: iban.

items.promptEnglish: I used to see/watch
items.explanation: ver keeps the e: veía, veías, veía, veíamos, veían.

items.prompt: Cuando era niño, ___ al fútbol todos los días. (jugar)
items.promptEnglish: When I was a child, I used to play football every day.
items.explanation: A repeated past habit takes the imperfect: jugaba.

items.promptEnglish: That day it was very cold.
items.explanation: Weather as background description takes the imperfect: hacía frío.

items.promptEnglish: It was three o'clock when he arrived.
items.explanation: Telling time in the past uses the imperfect: eran las tres.

items.promptEnglish: She was ten years old then.
items.explanation: Age in the past uses the imperfect: tenía diez años.

items.promptEnglish: While I was reading, the phone rang.
items.explanation: The ongoing background action takes the imperfect: leía.

items.promptEnglish: The house was big and old.
items.explanation: Description in the past uses the imperfect: era.

items.prompt: Todos los veranos ___ a la playa. (ir, nosotros)
items.promptEnglish: Every summer we used to go to the beach.
items.explanation: A recurring past habit takes the imperfect: íbamos.

items.prompt: De niño, ___ dibujos animados cada mañana. (ver, yo)
items.promptEnglish: As a child, I used to watch cartoons every morning.
items.explanation: Childhood habit + irregular ver: veía.

items.promptEnglish: I used to get up early every day.
items.explanation: A repeated habit ('used to') takes the imperfect, not the preterite.

items.promptEnglish: While she was studying, I was cooking.
items.explanation: 'Mientras' + ongoing background action → imperfect.

items.prompt: Put into the imperfect (habit): "Como pan" → "___ pan" (I used to eat bread).
items.promptEnglish: I used to eat bread.
items.explanation: comer → comía in the imperfect.

items.prompt: Escribe una frase en imperfecto sobre algo que hacías de niño/a.
items.promptEnglish: Write an imperfect sentence about something you used to do as a child.
items.guidance: Must be grammatical Spanish using the imperfect to describe a past habit or ongoing situation (e.g. 'De niño, jugaba en el parque todas las tardes'). Mark incorrect if it uses the preterite for a habit (e.g. 'jugué') or otherwise avoids the imperfect.
items.sampleAnswer: De niña, leía cuentos todas las noches antes de dormir.
items.explanation: Childhood habits take the imperfect.
